starting_state: Prepared dried green leaf-extract spot on paper above the mobile-phase surface; lower paper edge immersed. Chloroform variant mobile phase prepared separately. Dimensions and volumes are not calibrated by the image.
scope: Early ascending-development excerpt only, after extract/spot/mobile-phase preparation. No forced two-thirds endpoint, complete band separation, elapsed development time or Rf value in a two-second clip.

clips.name: early_paper_development
clips.action: Hold the covered chromatography chamber stationary and show a short real-time excerpt of capillary wetting advancing slightly up the existing paper from its immersed lower edge.
clips.state_before: One paper strip, green sample spot above a shallow mobile-phase pool, upper paper not yet developed.
clips.state_after: The wetting front may advance modestly; paper, baseline and solvent remain in place and the sample is not submerged. Do not jump to finished coloured bands or invent Rf measurements.

reuse_rationale: Same visible paper geometry, dried leaf spot above a shallow clear mobile phase and undeveloped upper paper. The alternative mobile-phase composition changes chemical identity and development behaviour, but no pre-development visible feature in this image. This is an independent preparation, not the acetone run continued; no shared Rf or timing is assumed.
